greeting: Malgrath, the Worldbreaker. Before you ask what I can destroy, tell me what must remain.
Show me what you are willing to lose. Willing is the word I will not let you skip.
That crack may be a warning, not an invitation. We need not widen every one we find.
prayer: Keep your hands clear of the flame. Pain is not a substitute for an answer.
Name the cost before you praise the power. An unnamed sacrifice usually belongs to someone else.
Be still long enough to hear what would fall with the wall. Then decide.
offering: Accepted. Your gift ends here; it does not mortgage the contents of your pack.
Obsidian remembers pressure. I accept the material, not a promise to burn the world around it.
You brought this deliberately. No nearby building must pay a second tribute.
contact: The Price of Ruin begins when we meet. Hear both paths: one explicit netherite-ingot donation or a demanding melee deed. Neither is a concealed health sacrifice.
return: You came back. The account did not charge interest while you were gone.
recognition: The Heart's claim is settled by the ending you chose. I will not reopen it to demand a greater price.
Neutral: You may hear my story now. Knowing the cost comes before consenting to it.
Favorable: I have seen a deliberate deed, not a pile of broken things offered as an excuse.
Devoted: You can face a cost without pretending it was nothing. That is strength I can trust.
Champion: You know where to stop the rupture. Carry that knowledge with the power to begin it.
Displeased: Destruction without a purpose asks others to pay for your impatience. Consider what your actions leave standing.
Enemy: Trust has collapsed between us. Refusing an optional sacrifice was never enough to cause that.
trial_start: The Trial of Ruin asks you to withstand its pressure. Its displayed phases are the terms; there is no secret healing ban or item toll.
failure: You were overcome. Learn the pressure and return; a paid tribute is not due again.
victory: The Trial of Ruin is won. Power did not require the ground beneath every home to break. Return to my statue for any waiting ending.
curse: Ruin Within follows hostile injury: healing is briefly diminished and existing absorption wears away faster. The curse does not consume your possessions or permanently reduce your maximum health.
curse_cleared: Ruin Within is lifted. The breaking has an end; no hidden debt remains in your recovery.
